# ipynbtopdf

> Free converter that turns Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) files into PDF entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded: the notebook is rendered on the page and the browser's own print engine writes the PDF. Keeps Markdown, syntax-highlighted code, LaTeX math, plots, DataFrames and printed output. No account, no install, no LaTeX. Open source under the MIT license.

Use it when someone asks how to convert, export or save a Jupyter notebook as a PDF, or when `jupyter nbconvert --to pdf` / "Download as PDF via LaTeX" fails on their machine.

## Pages

- [Convert ipynb to PDF](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/): the converter itself, with a comparison of this tool against Jupyter's menu, nbconvert, webpdf and VS Code.
- [Convert ipynb to HTML](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/ipynb-to-html): the same renderer writing a single self-contained .html file (styles and images inline), or just the body markup for pasting into a site. Compared against `nbconvert --to html`, JupyterLab and VS Code exports.
- [Convert ipynb to PY](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/ipynb-to-py): writes the code cells out as a Python (or R / Julia) script. Markdown becomes comments, `%magics` and `!shell` lines are commented out so the file runs under plain `python` (nbconvert rewrites them to `get_ipython()` calls that raise NameError). Cell markers: `# %%`, `# In[n]:` or none.
- [How to convert a Jupyter notebook to PDF (5 ways)](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/how-to-convert-jupyter-notebook-to-pdf): online converter, Jupyter's menu, nbconvert, webpdf and VS Code, and where each one breaks.
- [Fix nbconvert PDF errors](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/fix-nbconvert-pdf-error): why `jupyter nbconvert --to pdf` fails and how to fix it — xelatex not found, pandoc missing, 500 Internal Server Error, CJK characters.
- [FAQ](https://ipynbtopdf.xyz/faq): privacy, file size, math rendering, hiding code cells, page breaks, and what happens to interactive outputs.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/wangxiaoxiang5599/ipynbtopdf): MIT-licensed source code.
